name: Phase
blurb: Active:  Aphelios switches between his main weapon and off-hand weapon.

effects.description: Toggle: Aphelios switches between his main weapon and off-hand weapon over 0.25 seconds.

notes:
Toggled abilities do not count as ability activations for the purposes of on-cast effects such as  Spellblade and triggering  Force Pulse's passive.
Switching does not interrupt any commands Aphelios was issued before or during Phase.
